description:
We are seeking a Connected Car Service (CCS) Operations Developer to support the operation, maintenance, and enhancement of connected vehicle services and related data-processing systems.
 This position will focus on processing large volumes of data using Python, supporting ETL workflows, and developing and maintaining Java-based applications. The ideal candidate will have experience in backend development, data processing, system operations, and technical troubleshooting.
 Key Responsibilities
 Support the daily operation and maintenance of Connected Car Service systems
 Process and manage large volumes of data using Python
 Develop and maintain ETL processes for data extraction, transformation, validation, and loading
 Develop, modify, and maintain Java-based applications and services
 Monitor system performance and data-processing workflows
 Identify, investigate, and resolve application and data-related issues
 Perform troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for system errors
 Support system integrations, APIs, databases, and backend services
 Automate recurring operational and data-processing tasks
 Maintain technical documentation and operational procedures
 Collaborate with development, infrastructure, and business teams to resolve technical issues and improve service reliability
 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field
 Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in application development, data engineering, system operations, or a related field
 Hands-on experience with Python, particularly for large-scale data processing
 Experience developing or maintaining ETL workflows
 Working knowledge of Java and Java-based application development
 Experience with SQL and relational databases
 Understanding of backend services, APIs, and system integration
 Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
 Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and work effectively in a collaborative environment
 Strong communication and organizational skills
 Professional proficiency in both Korean and English is required 
 Preferred Qualifications
 Experience with Connected Car Services, telematics, mobility platforms, or automotive systems
 Experience processing vehicle, service, or other large-scale operational data
 Familiarity with Linux environments
 Experience with REST APIs, batch processing, and job-scheduling tools
 Experience with cloud-based data-processing environments
 Experience with system monitoring, incident response, or production support
 Additional Information
 This is a full-time, on-site position based in Duluth, Georgia . Candidates must be able to reliably commute to or relocate to the Duluth area.

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
